rationale: The analysis identifies the positional mapper as the corruption source, correctly treats validation as the downstream detector, recognizes retries as futile, and prioritizes named-field mapping plus stronger contract tests. Causal direction and protective-validator boundary are accurately represented. It includes useful, concrete uncertainties around sample scope, residual failures, silent corruption, and broader blast radius. Minor overreach includes describing the mapper mechanism as fully sufficient despite evidence that validation generated only the majority of visible errors, and projecting behavior of other consumers or counterfactual outcomes beyond directly established evidence.
